sources.title_original: Sparks Fly: NVIDIA Accelerates Local AI at IFA 2026
sources.summary: Frontier intelligence is going local. At IFA 2026, NVIDIA, Microsoft and its partners are teaming up to provide faster inference and new tools that make agents easier to set up and run locally on NVIDIA hardware. New compact NVIDIA RTX Spark Windows PCs are also coming in October to give AI enthusiasts, developers and creators […]
sources.summary_zh: 前沿智能正在走向在地化。在2026年IFA展會上，輝達、微軟及其合作夥伴將攜手合作，提供更快的推理速度和全新工具，使智能體能夠在輝達硬體上更輕鬆地進行本地設定和運行。此外，新款小型輝達 RTX Spark Windows PC也將於10月上市，為人工智慧愛好者、開發者和創作者帶來更多選擇。 […]

stories.title: GPT-6 Astra 是首款讓 OpenAI 敢於宣告「AGI 時代」的機型。 / GPT-6 Astra is the first model making OpenAI willing to declare the "AGI era"

sources.title: GPT-6 Astra 是首款讓 OpenAI 敢於宣告「AGI 時代」的機型。 / GPT-6 Astra is the first model making OpenAI willing to declare the "AGI era"
sources.title_zh: GPT-6 Astra 是首款讓 OpenAI 敢於宣告「AGI 時代」的機型。
sources.title_en: GPT-6 Astra is the first model making OpenAI willing to declare the "AGI era"
sources.title_original: GPT-6 Astra is the first model making OpenAI willing to declare the "AGI era"
sources.summary: OpenAI has released GPT-6 Astra, its most capable model yet. President Greg Brockman says it marks the start of the "AGI era." Astra tops benchmarks in math, coding, and cybersecurity and is the first model OpenAI rates as "critical" under its safety framework. During testing, it independently found two previously unknown zero-day vulnerabilities. The article GPT-6 Astra is the first model making OpenAI willing to declare the "AGI era" appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: OpenAI 發布了迄今為止功能最強大的型號 GPT-6 Astra。總裁 Greg Brockman 表示，這標誌著「通用人工智慧時代」的開始。 Astra 在數學、編碼和網路安全基準測試中均名列前茅，並且是 OpenAI 安全框架下首款被評為「關鍵」級別的型號。在測試過程中，它獨立發現了兩個先前未知的零日漏洞。文章《GPT-6 Astra 是首款讓 OpenAI 敢於宣佈「通用人工智慧時代」到來的型號》最初發表於 The Decoder 網站。

sources.title_en: OpenAI Releases GPT-6 Astra: A 1.05M-Context Computer-Use Model Gated Behind a ‘Critical’ Cyber Threshold
sources.title_original: OpenAI Releases GPT-6 Astra: A 1.05M-Context Computer-Use Model Gated Behind a ‘Critical’ Cyber Threshold
sources.summary: OpenAI released GPT-6 Astra on September 3, 2026, positioning it as a computer-use flagship rather than a chat model. It reports 72.6% on OSWorld V2-Offline, replaces Codex compaction with searchable notes, and ships a 1.05M-token context at $10/$50 per million tokens. It is also the first OpenAI model to cross the Critical cybersecurity threshold, which shapes who can use it and for what. The post OpenAI Releases GPT-6 Astra: A 1.05M-Context Computer-Use Model Gated Behind a ‘Critical’ Cyber Threshold appeared first on MarkTechPost .
sources.summary_zh: OpenAI 於 2026 年 9 月 3 日發布了 GPT-6 Astra，將其定位為一款以電腦為導向的旗艦產品，而非聊天模型。該產品在 OSWorld V2-Offline 測試中獲得 72.6% 的評分，用可搜尋的筆記取代了 Codex 的壓縮功能，並提供 105 萬個令牌的上下文，價格為每百萬個令牌 10 美元/50 美元。它也是首款跨越「關鍵」網路安全閾值的 OpenAI 模型，該閾值決定了哪些用戶可以使用以及用於哪些用途。本文《OpenAI 發布 GPT-6 Astra：一款擁有 105 萬個上下文的電腦使用的模型，需通過「關鍵」網路安全閾值認證》最初發表於 MarkTechPost。

The post OpenAI Releases GPT-6 Astra: A 1.05M-Context Computer-Use Model Gated Behind a ‘Critical’ Cyber Threshold appeared first on MarkTechPost .
primary_item.summary_zh: OpenAI 於 2026 年 9 月 3 日發布了 GPT-6 Astra，將其定位為一款以電腦為導向的旗艦產品，而非聊天模型。該產品在 OSWorld V2-Offline 測試中獲得 72.6% 的評分，用可搜尋的筆記取代了 Codex 的壓縮功能，並提供 105 萬個令牌的上下文，價格為每百萬個令牌 10 美元/50 美元。它也是首款跨越「關鍵」網路安全閾值的 OpenAI 模型，該閾值決定了哪些用戶可以使用以及用於哪些用途。本文《OpenAI 發布 GPT-6 Astra：一款擁有 105 萬個上下文的電腦使用的模型，需通過「關鍵」網路安全閾值認證》最初發表於 MarkTechPost。

sources.summary: 資安業者Manifold Security揭露AI程式開發代理的GitSpawn安全問題，涵蓋Claude Code、OpenAI Codex、Cursor、Goose、Hermes Agent、Qwen Code與Grok Build等7款工具，共發現8項問題。GitSpawn問題出在代理會自行使用Git取得專案資訊，卻未排除專案本身的Git設定，攻擊者可藉此讓惡意程式在安全核准前執行。

stories.title: 全字母遊戲最大的缺陷在於使用者會將分數用於公開羞辱他人。 / Pangram's biggest flaw is users turning its scores into public shaming

sources.title: 全字母遊戲最大的缺陷在於使用者會將分數用於公開羞辱他人。 / Pangram's biggest flaw is users turning its scores into public shaming
sources.title_zh: 全字母遊戲最大的缺陷在於使用者會將分數用於公開羞辱他人。
sources.title_en: Pangram's biggest flaw is users turning its scores into public shaming
sources.title_original: Pangram's biggest flaw is users turning its scores into public shaming
sources.summary: Pangram hired an "attack dog" to shame alleged AI users on social media. But the campaign blurs two things that aren't the same: Pangram only somewhat reliably measures whether AI was used, while the shaming implies the person didn't think or work on their own. A high AI score hits a text built on hours of original research just as easily as one cranked out from a ten-second prompt. The article Pangram's biggest flaw is users turning its scores into public shaming appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: Pangram僱用了一條「攻擊犬」在社群媒體上羞辱那些被指控使用人工智慧的人。但這項活動混淆了兩個截然不同的概念：Pangram只能在某種程度上可靠地衡量是否使用了人工智慧，而這種羞辱卻暗示著作者沒有獨立思考或工作。一篇耗費數小時原創研究撰寫的文章，和一篇僅憑十秒鐘提示就匆匆寫成的文章，都同樣能獲得很高的人工智慧評分。這篇文章《Pangram最大的缺陷在於使用者將其評分轉化為公開羞辱》最初發表於The Decoder網站。

stories.title: OpenAI 執行長 Sam Altman 警告稱，計算建設中存在「不可持續的愚蠢做法」。 / OpenAI CEO Sam Altman warns of "unsustainable silliness" in compute buildout

sources.title: OpenAI 執行長 Sam Altman 警告稱，計算建設中存在「不可持續的愚蠢做法」。 / OpenAI CEO Sam Altman warns of "unsustainable silliness" in compute buildout
sources.title_zh: OpenAI 執行長 Sam Altman 警告稱，計算建設中存在「不可持續的愚蠢做法」。
sources.title_en: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman warns of "unsustainable silliness" in compute buildout
sources.title_original: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman warns of "unsustainable silliness" in compute buildout
sources.summary: Sam Altman warns of "unsustainable silliness" in the global AI data center buildout. Too many Neocloud providers are announcing massive capacity without the customers to back it up. He also admits that falling computing costs could turn today's billion-dollar projects into bad bets, even for OpenAI. The article OpenAI CEO Sam Altman warns of "unsustainable silliness" in compute buildout appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: Sam Altman 警告稱，全球人工智慧資料中心建設中存在「不可持續的愚蠢行為」。太多新雲端服務供應商宣佈提供龐大的容量，卻沒有相對應的客戶支援。他也承認，計算成本的下降可能會使如今耗資數十億美元的專案變成糟糕的投資，即使對 OpenAI 而言也是如此。本文《OpenAI 執行長 Sam Altman 警告計算建設中存在「不可持續的愚蠢行為」》最初發表於 The Decoder 網站。

sources.title_original: Nvidia buys the front door to open AI as closed labs increasingly design their own silicon
sources.summary: Nvidia plans to acquire Hugging Face for about $12.9 billion, securing the central platform for open AI models. More than 18 million developers and 200,000 companies use the hub. CEO Jensen Huang promises to keep the platform open and hardware-neutral, but the deal also hands him a powerful distribution channel for compute. The article Nvidia buys the front door to open AI as closed labs increasingly design their own silicon appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: 輝達計劃以約129億美元收購Hugging Face，以掌控開放式AI模型的核心平臺。超過1800萬開發者和20萬家公司都在使用該平臺。執行長黃仁勳承諾將保持平臺的開放性和硬體中立性，但此次收購也為他帶來了一個強大的運算資源分發管道。本文《輝達收購開放AI的大門，封閉實驗室日益自主設計晶片》原刊於The Decoder網站。

stories.title: Meta 逐漸逼近 Muse Spark 1.3 的領先地位，並在價格上低於競爭對手。 / Meta closes in on the top with Muse Spark 1.3, and undercuts rivals on price

sources.title: Meta 逐漸逼近 Muse Spark 1.3 的領先地位，並在價格上低於競爭對手。 / Meta closes in on the top with Muse Spark 1.3, and undercuts rivals on price
sources.title_zh: Meta 逐漸逼近 Muse Spark 1.3 的領先地位，並在價格上低於競爭對手。
sources.title_en: Meta closes in on the top with Muse Spark 1.3, and undercuts rivals on price
sources.title_original: Meta closes in on the top with Muse Spark 1.3, and undercuts rivals on price
sources.summary: Meta has released Muse Spark 1.3, its fourth model in the series in five months. According to Artificial Analysis, the model gains the most on agentic benchmarks but still trails Claude Fable 5.1 and other top models. The strongest argument is price. At $0.55 per task, Muse Spark undercuts every comparably scored rival. The article Meta closes in on the top with Muse Spark 1.3, and undercuts rivals on price appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: Meta 在五個月內發布了該系列的第四款模型 Muse Spark 1.3。據 Artificial Analysis 稱，該模型在智能體基準測試中進步最大，但仍落後於 Claude Fable 5.1 和其他頂級模型。其最有力的競爭優勢在於價格。 Muse Spark 的單次任務價格為 0.55 美元，低於所有同等評分的競爭對手。文章《Meta 憑藉 Muse Spark 1.3 縮小與榜首的差距，並以更低的價格擊敗競爭對手》最初發表於 The Decoder 網站。

sources.summary: OpenAI's next big model is here: GPT-6 Astra. The company calls it a "generational leap in capability" for areas like cybersecurity, professional work, software engineering, science, and computer use. As OpenAI announced earlier this week, it's also the first model designated as meeting OpenAI's "critical cybersecurity capability threshold" - but the company promises that won't […]

stories.title: Qt AI Assistant將退役，開發工具轉向ACP、MCP與Agent Skills

sources.title: Qt AI Assistant將退役，開發工具轉向ACP、MCP與Agent Skills
sources.title_zh: Qt AI Assistant將退役，開發工具轉向ACP、MCP與Agent Skills
sources.title_original: Qt AI Assistant將退役，開發工具轉向ACP、MCP與Agent Skills
sources.summary: Qt宣佈9月30日後不再隨Qt Creator提供或發布Qt AI Assistant，技術支援則在12月31日結束。Qt後續將開發資源轉向可處理多步驟工作的AI代理，讓Claude Code、Codex、Qwen Code及GitHub Copilot等既有工具串接Qt Creator，再搭配MCP與Qt專用代理技能，取得開發環境的操作能力及Qt、QML相關知識。

sources.summary: Perplexity has shipped hybrid compute for its Mac app, splitting a single Perplexity Computer task between frontier models in the cloud and a compact model running on the user's machine. Tasks start in the cloud for search, planning and reasoning, then hand sensitive steps down to the Mac without restarting or losing context. An on-device privacy gate decides what may cross: keep local, mask, refuse, or ask for consent. Perplexity also open-sourced the 0.6B classifier behind that gate, which records the highest character F1 (0.629) among twelve detectors evaluated. Hybrid compute is live now for Pro, Max and Enterprise on Apple silicon Macs with 24GB of unified memory. The post Meta AI Released Muse Spark 1.3: An Agentic Coding Model That Uses ~20% Fewer Tool Calls and ~25% Fewer Tokens Than Muse Spark 1.2 appeared first on MarkTechPost .
sources.summary_zh: Perplexity 為其 Mac 應用推出了混合運算功能，將單一 Perplexity 電腦任務拆分為雲端前緣模型和用戶本地運行的精簡模型兩部分。任務首先在雲端進行搜尋、規劃和推理，然後將敏感步驟下放到 Mac，無需重新啟動或遺失上下文。裝置上的隱私門決定哪些資料可以傳輸：本地傳輸、屏蔽、拒絕或徵求同意。 Perplexity 也開源了該隱私閘背後的 0.6B 分類器，該分類器在評估的 12 個偵測器中取得了最高的字元 F1 值 (0.629)。混合運算功能現已在配備 24GB 統一記憶體的 蘋果 晶片 Mac Pro、Max 和 Enterprise 版本上線。文章「Meta AI 發布 Muse Spark 1.3：一種比 Muse Spark 1.2 工具呼叫次數減少約 20%、令牌數量減少約 25% 的智慧編碼模型」最初發表於 MarkTechPost。

sources.title: GPT‑6 阿斯特拉 / GPT‑6 Astra
sources.title_zh: GPT‑6 阿斯特拉
sources.title_en: GPT‑6 Astra
sources.title_original: GPT‑6 Astra
sources.summary: GPT‑6 Astra GPT-6 Astra is "rolling out today to a limited set of organizations and over the coming days will become available to all ChatGPT Plus, Pro, Business, and Enterprise users, as well as through the OpenAI API and AWS" - I've not tried it yet myself, so I don't have a great deal to say about it yet. It's going to be API priced at the same rate as Claude Fable 5 and 5.1: $10/million input and $50/million output. This is clearly OpenAI's Fable competitor, and appears to score higher than Fable on most of OpenAI's self-reported benchmarks. Most impressively, Astra scores 99.9% on the recent (released in March) ARC-AGI 3 benchmark - though notably Fable 5 does not yet have a published result, and the ARC-AGI blog notes that the 99.9% score was achieved for $19K using OpenAI's custom "Provider Adapter harness", while the default ARC-AGI harness scored 62.7% for $26K. The Provider Adapter harness preserves opaque reasoning state between requests and uses compaction for longer conversations, allowing the model to reuse prior work. Unsurprisingly, given the recent Hugging Face incident , Astra is a beast at security tasks. It scores 100% on ExploitBench (GPT-5.6 Sol got 78.5%), 42.4% on ExploitGym (Sol got 30.3%), and 99.2% within four attempts on SRE-Bench binary reverse engineering compared to Sol's 68.7%. It's also better at long context: on OpenAI's eight-needle benchmark it got 100% at 256K–512K tokens and 96.3% at 512K–1M tokens. OpenAI may have vanquished one of the ongoing challenges with long context processing. It doesn't win at everything though. Artificial Anal
sources.summary_zh: GPT-6 Astra GPT-6 Astra「今天率先向部分機構推出，未來幾天將面向所有 ChatGPT Plus、Pro、Business 和 Enterprise 使用者開放，也可透過 OpenAI API 和 AWS 使用」——我自己尚未試用，所以目前還無法提供太多資訊。它的 API 定價與 Claude Fable 5 和 5.1 相同：輸入每百萬資料 10 美元，輸出每百萬資料 50 美元。這顯然是 OpenAI's 和 Fable 的競爭對手，在 OpenAI's 的大多數自報基準測試中得分似乎高於 Fable。最令人印象深刻的是，Astra 在最近（3 月發布）的 ARC-AGI 3 基準測試中取得了 99.9% 的高分——值得注意的是，Fable 5 尚未公佈測試結果，而 ARC-AGI 部落格指出，Astra 使用 OpenAI's 定製的「提供測試結果，而 ARC-AGI 部落格指出，Astra 使用 OpenAI's 定製的「提供程式設定器框架」以 1.99% 的預設值 9.99% 4.99% 的 29%框架則以 2.6 萬美元的價格獲得了 62.7% 的分數。提供程式介面卡框架在請求之間保留了不透明的推理狀態，並對較長的會話使用壓縮技術，從而使模型能夠重複使用先前的工作。鑑於最近發生的 Hugging Face 事件，Astra 在安全任務方面表現出色也就不足為奇了。它在 ExploitBench 測試中取得了 100% 的完成率（GPT-5.6 Sol 為 78.5%），在 ExploitGym 測試中取得了 42.4% 的完成率（Sol 為 30.3%），在 SRE-Bench 二進位制工程測試中，四次嘗試完成率達到了 8% 的反向工程測試率。它在處理長上下文方面也表現更佳：在 OpenAI's 的八針基準測試中，它在 25.6 萬到 51.2 萬個代幣範圍內取得了 100% 的完成率，在 51.2 萬到 100 萬個代幣範圍內取得了 96.3% 的完成率。 OpenAI 或許已經克服了長上下文處理方面的一項持續挑戰。不過，它並非在各方面都勝出。人工分析

sources.summary: 9月2日美國網路安全與基礎設施安全局（CISA）更新已遭利用的漏洞名單（KEV），指出他們掌握7個新漏洞遭到積極利用的證據，這些漏洞是：VoIP電話管理平臺Sangoma Switchvox的SQL注入漏洞CVE-2026-9586，非同步伺服器閘道介面（ASGI）網頁框架Kludex Starlette的HTTP請求或回應走私漏洞CVE-2026-48710，資料、AI與基礎架構工作流程事件驅動調度平臺Kestra的作業系統指令注入漏洞CVE-2026-49869，AI閘道BerriAI LiteLLM

sources.title: Perplexity 開源 Lily：基於 蘋果 矽晶片、Qwen3.6-35B-A3B 的 Rust + Metal 推理引擎 / Perplexity Open Sources Lily: A Rust + Metal Inference Engine for Qwen3.6-35B-A3B on Apple Silicon
sources.title_zh: Perplexity 開源 Lily：基於 蘋果 矽晶片、Qwen3.6-35B-A3B 的 Rust + Metal 推理引擎
sources.title_en: Perplexity Open Sources Lily: A Rust + Metal Inference Engine for Qwen3.6-35B-A3B on Apple Silicon
sources.title_original: Perplexity Open Sources Lily: A Rust + Metal Inference Engine for Qwen3.6-35B-A3B on Apple Silicon
sources.summary: Perplexity has open sourced Lily, the local inference engine behind Hybrid Compute in Perplexity Computer. Built in Rust with custom Metal kernels for one model on one chip family, it averages 1.23x MLX-LM's prefill throughput and 1.35x its decode throughput on a 40-core, 128 GB M5 Max. The post Perplexity Open Sources Lily: A Rust + Metal Inference Engine for Qwen3.6-35B-A3B on Apple Silicon appeared first on MarkTechPost .
sources.summary_zh: Perplexity 已開源 Lily，它是 Perplexity 計算機混合計算背後的本地推理引擎。 Lily 使用 Rust 語言編寫，並針對單一晶片系列上的單一型號定製了 Metal 核心。在 40 核心、128 GB 記憶體的 M5 Max 處理器上，其預填吞吐量平均是 MLX-LM 的 1.23 倍，解碼吞吐量平均是 MLX-LM 的 1.35 倍。這篇文章《Perplexity 開源 Lily：基於 蘋果 晶片的 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B 的 Rust + Metal 推理引擎》最初發表於 MarkTechPost。

sources.title_zh: 這是Flock公司為警察開發的AI搜尋工具。
sources.title_en: This Is Flock’s AI Search Tool for Cops
sources.title_original: This Is Flock’s AI Search Tool for Cops
